title: Stop Writing Prompts. Start Building Loops.
description:
The future of AI is not just better prompts.

It is better workflows.

A prompt gives you one answer.

A loop gives AI an objective and lets it keep working: researching, checking, improving and repeating until the task is complete.

That is the difference between using AI as a chatbot and building systems that can actually execute.

🚀 You’ll find the link to our free AI classes in our profile
